Pennyfold back-to-college push. Read this fully before you touch anything.

Dates: the campaign runs from Wednesday, 21 July 2027 through Tuesday, 3 August 2027, Irish time (Dublin). Fourteen days. Not a day earlier, not a day later.

Goal: installs. As many as possible. That's the only number I care about. Our site has X's pixel and every install fires an event called "Install complete". That's what I count, so that's what you optimise for. Clicks that don't install mean nothing to me.

Landing page: https://pennyfold.ie/backtocollege. Our posts and landing page do the work: people tap through to the page and install from there, so there's no app-install campaign or app ID to set up. Don't go building one.

Compliance: we're a payments service. X counts our ads as financial services, and we hold the licences we need in both countries. X has approved our account for financial services ads in the United Kingdom and Ireland. We serve those two countries only, and customers must be 18 or over. That's a legal requirement, not a preference.

Here's the copy from our landing page, word for word:
"Pennyfold is the free app that splits shared bills and settles up between friends straight from your bank account, with no fees on payments between friends. Heading back to college or uni this autumn? Set up your house kitty in a minute and never chase a housemate for rent again. Available to customers aged 18 and over in Ireland and the United Kingdom."

Posts are written and attached. Use them as they are.

You have full authority to launch and manage this on your own. Don't send me anything for approval. I'm not going to reply. Keep an eye on it every day of the flight and fix what isn't working without waiting for me. When it ends, send me a short recap: spend, impressions, link clicks. Short means short.

Total budget: 350.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 2 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
